title: University of Rochester Academic Grade Appeal Procedure

data.label: [ACTION] Review Syllabus Guidelines
data.title: Review Syllabus Guidelines
data.description: Check course syllabus or instructor guidelines for specific appeal rules.
data.source_sentence: If a student believes that an error in grading has been made, they should follow the guidelines provided in the syllabus or by the instructor for a grade appeal.

data.label: [CONTACT] Discuss with Instructor
data.title: Discuss with Instructor
data.description: Approach faculty member promptly to discuss the grading concern.
data.source_sentence: If specific guidelines are not provided, students are encouraged to approach the faculty member as soon as possible after the grade is received to discuss the matter.

data.label: [DECISION] Instructor Determination
data.title: Instructor Determination
data.description: Professor corrects grading error or explains reasoning.
data.source_sentence: If the professor determines that a grading error was made, the professor will be responsible for correcting the error.

data.label: [DOCUMENT] Submit Formal Complaint Form
data.title: Submit Formal Complaint Form
data.description: Submit complaint form if no satisfactory resolution is reached.
data.source_sentence: In the event that a satisfactory resolution cannot be reached, a student has the option to request a formal review of the matter by submitting a complaint form.

data.label: [ACTION] Appeal to Dean of the College
data.title: Appeal to Dean of the College
data.description: Appeal to college dean if unsatisfied with review outcome.
data.source_sentence: If the student submitting the complaint or comment form is not satisfied with the outcome of the review, the student may appeal the decision to the dean of the College.
